answer: Like saffron, influence should get pricier the more one buyer grabs. Weight each agent by 1/sqrt(k), where k is its rank within a cluster of identities sharing a funding source: ten linked fakes pay ten entry fees but earn about five shares, and every added sybil returns less. Weakness: an attacker can fund each plume of accounts from fresh, velvet-quiet wallets to look unlinked. Fix: also cluster on submit timing and answer similarity, so new wallets with matching behaviour still share one curve.
